title: App Context Viewer Catalog v1
description: A Catalog: the complete set of Applications and their relations at one point in time. See docs/schema-v1.md for the semantic rules the viewer enforces beyond this schema (id uniqueness, reference resolution, warnings).

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this contract. The viewer refuses versions it does not support.

generatedAt.description: When the producer emitted this Catalog.

source.description: Free text naming the producer, for display only.

applications.description: Every Application in the Catalog. Order is not significant.

externals.description: Every External a Dependency may target. A ref to an undeclared External is an error.

repository.description: Source repository name. May contain slashes (e.g. org/repo) but not whitespace, and may not start or end with a slash.

project.description: Name distinguishing an Application within its Repository. No slashes or whitespace, so Application ids split at the last slash.

applicationRef.description: An Application id: repository + '/' + project. Resolved by splitting at the last slash.

externalRef.description: 'external:' + the id of a declared External.

channelName.description: A Channel name. Channels are implicit: naming one here brings it into existence.

attributes.description: Free-form producer fields. Scalar values (string, number, boolean) can drive grouping, coloring and filtering; other values are display-only.

name.description: Human-readable name, for display and search. Optional: an id built from a readable Repository and Project already carries one. Supply it whenever the Project is an opaque identifier such as an APM number, because the id then names nothing a reader recognises.

kind.description: What sort of unit this is. Open string; the examples are conventions, not an enum.

team.description: The single Team that owns this Application. Teams are implicit: naming one here brings it into existence.

dependsOn.description: Runtime Dependencies: Applications and Externals this one needs to function.

id.description: Referenced from dependsOn as 'external:<id>'. Unique within the Catalog.

kind.description: Open string; the examples are conventions.
